endorsements.quote: Establishing an official hospital AI oversight governing body that would promote best practices could ensure the trustworthy implementation of these new technologies.

unlisted_practices: Develop additional AI models that check LLM outputs for factual accuracy, plagiarism, and copyright infringement.
Use calibration and fine-tuning with specialized datasets from the target population and reinforcement learning with human feedback to guide model behavior in health care LLM products.
Use human-in-the-loop approaches, adversarial training, and more diverse training data to reduce LLM hallucinations.
Do not use LLMs as a substitute for human interaction and personalized care in mental health care.

screen.reason: This is a commentary/perspective article discussing the potential benefits, pitfalls, and governance/ethical considerations of ChatGPT and LLMs in healthcare.
